title: Uncomfortable
subtitle: 「不舒服／不安／尷尬／局促／疼痛／令人難受」，究竟是哪一種 uncomfortable？
description: 「不舒服／不安／尷尬／局促／疼痛／令人難受」，究竟是哪一種 uncomfortable？

words.meaning: 不安的；心神不寧的；不自在的
words.note: 使用者提供。uneasy 最常形容因擔心、懷疑或不確定而感到心理不安。它比一般 uncomfortable 更偏 anxiety / apprehension，而不是物理疼痛。
words.example: She felt uneasy about walking home alone.

exercises.original: He felt uncomfortable about the sudden change in the company's finances.
exercises.zh: 他對公司財務狀況的突然變化感到不安。
exercises.upgrade: uneasy · 不安的；心神不寧的；不自在的

options.explanation: sudden change + concern about finances points to apprehension rather than social awkwardness.
偏社交尷尬、難以自然應對。 但本題的具體線索是 worry about an uncertain situation；這句真正要表達的是「心理上的擔心或不安」。因此 awkward 雖然與 uncomfortable 有重疊，情緒來源、身體感受或社交功能並不最吻合。
廣義令人不快、討厭或不舒服。 但本題的具體線索是 worry about an uncertain situation；這句真正要表達的是「心理上的擔心或不安」。因此 unpleasant 雖然與 uncomfortable 有重疊，情緒來源、身體感受或社交功能並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: uneasy 更偏心理擔憂、不確定或不安；物理座位不舒服通常不用 uneasy。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She felt uneasy about the decision. The chair was uncomfortable.

falseSynonyms.zh: awkward 更偏社交尷尬、對話彆扭或難以應對；疼痛、氣味等不屬 awkward。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There was an awkward silence. The shoes were uncomfortable.

falseSynonyms.zh: unpleasant 是較廣的『令人不快』；uncomfortable 可以更具體是疼痛、侷促或社交不自在。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The smell was unpleasant. The seat was uncomfortable.

falseSynonyms.zh: embarrassed 需要具體尷尬／出醜／被注意的情緒；uncomfortable 可以沒有 shame。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He was embarrassed by the mistake. He felt uncomfortable in the crowded room.

falseSynonyms.zh: painful 強度更高，要求有實際疼痛；一般 mild discomfort 不一定 painful。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The injury was painful. The seat was uncomfortable after an hour.

falseSynonyms.zh: cramped 只表示空間太小／擁擠；心理上的不舒服不能叫 cramped。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The back seat felt cramped. The conversation felt uncomfortable.

falseSynonyms.zh: distressing 指明顯情緒痛苦；一般尷尬或不便未必達到 distressing。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The footage was distressing. The pause was awkward.

falseSynonyms.zh: comfortless 是較少見、偏文學的詞，表示缺乏舒適或安慰；現代一般英語不把它當 uncomfortable 的普通替代。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The room felt cold and comfortless. The chair was uncomfortable.
